name: identity_music_beds_generate
title: Generate identity music bed
description: App-only Brand/Music Studio generation. Composes a real instrumental music bed with a music model (Lyria 3 Pro by default, or Eleven Music) and materializes it as an account-owned IdentityMusicBed row, with the current project as origin when project_id is given (omit it to bake at the account level from Music Studio). The prompt describes the musical character (genre, instruments, mood, BPM); bed doctrine (instrumental, speech-friendly, loopable) is applied server-side. If provider/storage is unavailable, returns blockers without creating a browser-only library fork.

project_id.description: Project public ID. Omit to bake at the account level.

prompt.description: Musical character of the bed: genre, instruments, mood, tempo. Instrumental/speech-friendly framing is added automatically.

duration_seconds.description: Optional track length in seconds (15-180, default 60).

prompt_influence.description: Deprecated; ignored by the music providers.
